sources.title: A Reduction of Imitation Learning and Structured Prediction to No-Regret Online Learning
sources.actual_inputs: Observations/states induced by learner/expert mixture; queried expert actions.
sources.objective_or_targets: Supervised surrogate on aggregate learner-induced states.
sources.updated_quantities: Stationary student policy; dataset grows across rounds.
sources.established_overlap: Student-state collection and aggregation already established.
sources.unresolved_comparison: History is an allowed policy input; this is not proof that DAgger cannot learn information gathering.

sources.title: Robot Learning on the Job: Human-in-the-Loop Autonomy and Learning During Deployment
sources.actual_inputs: Robot RGB and proprioception; demonstrations, autonomous actions, intervention and pre-intervention categories.
sources.objective_or_targets: Weighted behavioral cloning; intervention upweighting and pre-intervention suppression.
sources.updated_quantities: BC-RNN parameters and finite deployment memory across rounds.
sources.established_overlap: Deployment corrections improving autonomy and reducing human workload are prior art.
sources.unresolved_comparison: Retaining failed observations as context must be distinguished from giving their actions zero loss.

sources.title: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies
sources.actual_inputs: Image, proprioception, language and action-chunk sequences; robot mistakes and human correction segments.
sources.objective_or_targets: Flow-matching targets only on corrections; failed actions remain context; self-supervised fast-weight updates.
sources.updated_quantities: Slow weights and fast-weight initialization in training; fast weights within rollout; reset each rollout.
sources.established_overlap: Failures-as-context, corrections-as-targets and recovery without a runtime human are directly implemented.
sources.unresolved_comparison: Non-TTT backbones and changing benchmarks are not gaps; novel information-acquisition claims require additional evidence.

sources.title: Learning to Learn Faster from Human Feedback with Language Model Predictive Control
sources.actual_inputs: Human-language feedback and robot reward-code conversations.
sources.objective_or_targets: Successful-session continuation; Rollouts predicts future exchanges, Skip predicts final code.
sources.updated_quantities: PaLM-2 slow parameters offline; conversation context and receding-horizon search online.
sources.established_overlap: Fast adaptation followed by offline absorption to improve future teachability already exists.
sources.unresolved_comparison: Action-level vision control differs from code/feedback interface but alone supplies no methodological novelty.
sources.reported_limitation: The paper reports no observed benefit from multiple ICL/fine-tuning cycles; this is its setting-specific finding, not a shared failure theorem.

sources.title: In-context Reinforcement Learning with Algorithm Distillation
sources.actual_inputs: Multi-episode observations, executed actions and rewards from learning runs.
sources.updated_quantities: Sequence-model weights offline; context online without slow-weight gradients.
sources.established_overlap: Distilling a learning process rather than only a converged policy is prior art.
sources.unresolved_comparison: Jointly changing collectors and datasets are a comparison question, not established AD failure.

sources.title: Supervised Pretraining Can Learn In-Context Reinforcement Learning
sources.actual_inputs: Task interaction datasets plus query state; optimal or PPO action labels.
sources.objective_or_targets: Supervised query-action prediction conditioned on context.
sources.updated_quantities: Decision transformer parameters offline; interaction context online.
sources.established_overlap: Supervised acquisition of in-context adaptation and posterior-sampling behavior has direct precedent.
sources.unresolved_comparison: Compliance/coverage and ideal-fit assumptions qualify theory; they do not imply empirical failure.
sources.reported_limitation: Conclusion qualifies optimal-action pretraining and practical-versus-theoretical posterior-sampling differences.

sources.title: Robust Asymmetric Learning in POMDPs
sources.actual_inputs: Privileged state for expert; observation/action window as learner belief proxy.
sources.objective_or_targets: Refine expert for expected return of its implicit partially observed imitator; imitation projection.
sources.updated_quantities: Expert via policy gradient, student via asymmetric imitation, value estimators.
sources.established_overlap: Teacher information mismatch and adapting teaching to student observability already addressed.
sources.unresolved_comparison: Belief-conditioned recovery teaching is not new by itself; full theorem/appendix audit remains pending.

sources.title: Distilling Realizable Students from Unrealizable Teachers
sources.actual_inputs: Privileged-context teacher and context-hidden student; discriminator trajectories; teacher recovery states.
sources.objective_or_targets: CritiQ selective corrections plus discriminator objective; ReTRy RL with adaptive recovery resets.
sources.updated_quantities: Student, discriminator, or RL/reset buffer depending on method.
sources.established_overlap: Privileged action conflicts, correction timing and recovery initialization already addressed.
sources.unresolved_comparison: CritiQ criticality definitions vary in prose; reimplementation must resolve discriminator labels/sign rather than claiming a guarantee.

sources.title: RoboMME: Benchmarking and Understanding Memory for Robotic Generalist Policies
sources.actual_inputs: Current images/proprioception/instruction and native initial demonstration/history.
sources.objective_or_targets: Native action prediction with alternative memory representations/integrations.
sources.updated_quantities: π0.5 memory-augmented model training; causal memory during rollout.
sources.established_overlap: Frame sampling and memory-as-modulator are upstream contributions we reuse.
sources.unresolved_comparison: Current history-span comparison can change demo retention; it cannot isolate self-feedback acquisition.

sources.title: Autonomous Improvement of Instruction Following Skills via Foundation Models
sources.actual_inputs: VLM task proposals, generated image goals, autonomous robot data and VLM success labels.
sources.objective_or_targets: Goal-conditioned behavioral cloning with hindsight goals and autonomous data.
sources.updated_quantities: Goal-conditioned policy fine-tuned; semantic proposal/generation components reused.
sources.established_overlap: Autonomous robotic experience generation and policy improvement already exist.
sources.unresolved_comparison: This is robot SOAR, arXiv:2407.20635, not the separate mathematics experience-generation work.
sources.reported_limitation: Appendix H identifies using unsuccessful trajectories and acquiring skills absent from pretraining as future directions.

sources.title: IdeaScientist: Orchestrating Agents for Grounded Scientific Ideation
sources.actual_inputs: Problem setting and challenge; same-problem nearest-neighbor evidence.
sources.objective_or_targets: Grounded gap with limitation, importance and observable evidence route; at most two per axis.
sources.updated_quantities: Research artifacts; not a robotics algorithm.
sources.established_overlap: Audit procedure only; not evidence that our proposed robotics gaps exist.
sources.unresolved_comparison: We adopt the audit schema without reproducing the agent system.
